chunks: I asked him about the Word of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
Who is there that will lend to Allah a good loan, so He will multiply it for him, and for him is a noble reward.
He said: It was revealed regarding helping the Imam.

key_terms.أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ: a noble reward granted by Allah
key_terms.صِلَةِ الْإِمَامِ: supporting, maintaining ties with, or assisting the Imam
key_terms.قَرْضًا حَسَنًا: a good loan, meaning a righteous offering or support
key_terms.قَوْلِ اللَّهِ: the Word of Allah being asked about for its meaning
key_terms.يُقْرِضُ اللَّهَ: to offer a goodly loan to Allah, meaning an act done sincerely for His sake

ai.seo_question: What does “Who is there that will lend to Allah a good loan” mean in relation to the Imam عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This narration explains the Qur’anic phrase about giving Allah a good loan as referring to supporting and helping the Imam عليه السلام. It highlights that such support is treated as a divinely rewarded act with noble recompense.
